label: Sec. 02  The Principles
title: Themes
description: These themes are ways to keep systems open to the people using them, rather than locked behind technical language or proprietary platforms.

themes.title: Ownership
themes.description: Control over your work, your tools, and your identity.

themes.title: Permanence
themes.description: Building on protocols and mediums that outlast closed platforms.

themes.title: Energy
themes.description: Grounding digital systems in physical, verifiable reality.

themes.title: Peers
themes.description: Fostering direct, unmediated collaboration between humans.
